lines: (Bruno's frozen too. When he talks, his voice is low and slow and very Italian.)
Thomething... is howling. In MY Galaxity. On my day off.
(He takes a big breath, like Leo's learning to.) ...Okay. It'th probably Rook. It'th always Rook.
(A little hippo in a black SK8 beanie skids up on his board.) Yo! You came through the portal too? Bruno. Nina'th brother.
Yeah, here I am. Don't athk me how. Nina'th one too. We match. She thays that's thpecial. I thay it's thkating.
(He grins. There's a gap where a tooth should be.) Thkate Park'th mine. Come by. I teach the leththonth now. Rook helpth.
You haven't done my leththon yet? Lesson Pad, right there. Rook'th the cheerleader. I'm the coach.
{player}: What's the first thing you teach?
Puthing. Then ollieth. Then thtyle. You can't teach thtyle. But I'll try.
Thtill thkating? Good. Try my Offer You Can't Refuthe: get the thpecial meter full and press Flip and Grab together.
(He drops his voice.) ...It makes the ramp an offer. And the ramp... thays yeth.
Morning. Nina'th already at the lake. I'm waiting for the thkate park to warm up. Ramps are cold in the morning. That'th thcience.
Thtardutht noodleth by the lake. From the market. They glow. My tongue'th glowing now, look. Bleh.
Thun'th going down. Back on Earth it'th thtill only, like, half patht midnight. Thith place is weird. I love it.

rotate: Rex thays I should run for mayor. Of the thkate park. I'd win.
Dash thayth hith BMX is fathter than my board. We're racing at the Lake Loop. Thomeday.
When I'm thtressed my voice goes all... (deep voice) ...Italian. Nina thays it'th my 'other part'. I think it'th cool.
The Gloops keep thtealing my wheelth. Not cool, Gloopth. NOT. COOL.
